svg.title: Отведение руки в сторону на нижнем блоке — положение 1
svg.desc: Original ImageGen hollow contour, vector traced. SINGLE-ARM low-pulley cable lateral raise, front view. A clearly drawn small cable stack with pulley just above ground stands to the athlete's LEFT in EACH panel. Athlete's RIGHT hand holds ONE D-handle; a single taut diagonal cable leads visibly and continuously from the low pulley on the LEFT, across in front of the legs to RIGHT hand. LEFT hand rests on left hip in BOTH panels, absolutely no equipment in left hand. Left phase: right hand begins just in front of right thigh. Right phase: right arm raises sideways to right shoulder height with gently bent elbow, hand still holding D-handle, same diagonal cable tied to low pulley at lower left. Do not draw a cable terminating at feet or held in both hands. Expert biomechanics approval pending.
